description: Held-out tasks for the LoRA SFT proposal (docs/proposals/20261101-lora-sft.md). Never used for training or checkpoint selection; the only selection signal for an adapter.
selection: Deterministic, repository-stratified: for each repository the ids are sorted and picked at evenly spaced positions (round(i*(n-1)/(k-1))) with targets fastapi 15, rich 11, requests 3, httpx 0, giving 29 of 129. Chosen before any trajectory existed, so the split cannot leak into the dataset.
